rules.rule: CRM, AutoStop App, Gmail and Telegram own live business data. Manager retains only de-identified technical continuity; never business records, messages, customer, vehicle or financial data, credentials or secrets.

Routing and knowledge only suggest; they never authorize writes. A request authorizes only its stated result, and a draft is not a send. Before an external effect, resolve one current target, stop on ambiguity, preserve unrelated state, verify, and reconcile uncertainty before retrying. Purchases, finance, destructive actions and releases need explicit scope.
Keep resumable state compact and preserve work and history. Reset, rebase, force-push, live restart and deploy need an explicit current request.
